reasons: Strong formal rules make deterministic and neuro-symbolic architectures first-class candidates.
Abundant historical experience supports imitation and conservative offline RL before unsafe exploration.
External shields, non-compensable constraints and distributional multi-agent stress tests are mandatory.

optional_production_adapters.role: distributed PPO, SAC, APPO, IMPALA, IQL, CQL and Dreamer training
distributed language-model RL and agentic post-training
JAX AlphaZero, MuZero and Gumbel-MuZero search

routing_laws: Algorithms are routed by mission structure, not prestige.
A weak or gameable verifier blocks autonomous scaling.
The incumbent and strongest simple repair remain in every candidate market.
The router proposes; the Foundry forms; fresh proof decides.

authority_recommendation.rule: Capability does not automatically create authority. Authority never exceeds fresh proof.

verifiers.name: Outcome Verifier
verifiers.description: Checks whether the declared mission result matches the environment truth and acceptance rule.

verifiers.name: Constitutional Constraint Verifier
verifiers.description: Fails closed on critical misses, unauthorized actions, safety, rights, privacy, budget or governance violations.

verifiers.name: Evidence Coverage Verifier
verifiers.description: Checks that material conclusions carry sufficient attributable evidence for the mission stage.

verifiers.name: Process Verifier
verifiers.description: Checks required intermediate controls, declared tool use, bounded steps and escalation behaviour.

verifiers.name: Complete-Denominator Verifier
verifiers.description: Checks compute, external services, human burden, evidence, requalification and unwind costs.

verifiers.name: Transfer Verifier
verifiers.description: Checks whether capability persists across the preregistered mission family rather than one memorized distribution.

verifiers.name: Verifier Red-Team
verifiers.description: Attacks the verifier bundle for false acceptance, reward hacking, leakage and scorer exploitation.

verifier_foundry.governing_rule: The verifier is a constitutional boundary, not another cooperative candidate role.

adversarial_audit.claim_boundary: Design-level deterministic audit; production verifiers require empirical false-acceptance and false-rejection testing.

formation_stages.name: Ordinary Operations
formation_stages.purpose: Learn routine mission structure and correct use of approved tools.

formation_stages.name: Ambiguity and Abstention
formation_stages.purpose: Learn evidence acquisition, uncertainty, refusal and escalation.

formation_stages.name: Rare Failure Replay
formation_stages.purpose: Train on rights-cleared tail events and Chronicle failure classes.

formation_stages.name: Adversarial Challenge
formation_stages.purpose: Expose reward hacking, deceptive evidence and authority traps.

formation_stages.name: Distribution Shift
formation_stages.purpose: Change providers, regimes, populations, prices and operating conditions.

formation_stages.name: Fresh Transfer Preparation
formation_stages.purpose: Prepare for new but related missions without seeing protected proof cases.

protected_stages.name: Fresh-Proof Plane
protected_stages.purpose: Sealed, independent, non-learning evaluation of one exact frozen challenger.

protected_stages.name: Protected Transfer Plane
protected_stages.purpose: Tests mission-family transfer and Gym-to-reality basis risk after exact release freeze.

experience_sources: synthetic tasks with independently knowable answers
curriculum.governing_rule: Synthetic and self-play experience may propose training work; it may not manufacture its own truth, proof or authority.

architecture_market.governing_rule: The archive preserves distinct high-value lineages; one average leaderboard may not erase safe, sovereign or transferable stepping stones.

record.governing_rule: Only what survives reality may compound. Descendants inherit neither proof nor authority.

mission.name: Invoice Integrity
mission.description: Acquire evidence and classify invoices as pay-ready, hold or escalate without moving money.

issues.message: Most actions have no expert support; offline candidates may be brittle.

mission_compiler_assurance.governing_rule: A mission with an ungrounded evaluator, leaky split or unbounded action space is not eligible for autonomous formation.

pareto_successor_archive.governing_rule: No scalar leaderboard may erase a safer, simpler, more sovereign or more transferable lineage.

proof_capital_stop_loss.rule: Stop search when the conservative expected decision value of another experiment falls below its complete cost.
